description.narrative: SSM has since 2012 provided support for improvement of nuclear security capacity in Moldova. Within the framework of this support the Nuclear Security Support Centre (NSSC) at the Technical University of Moldova was opened in 2014. In 2017 SSM continued its support to the improvement of NSSC teaching and technical training base. The NSSC training laboratory was supplemented with radiation detection and measuring equipment. NSSCE experts modified curriculum on nuclear safety, and radiation protection, introducing a new component on nuclear safety-safeguards-nonproliferation interference. This new educational component was included and tested in the national training courses at NSSC for relevant staff of medical institutions of Moldova. NSSC organized a one-day seminar on radiological and nuclear safety issues for students with an invited French expert.
